story.title: Rainbow
paragraphs_en: “Hi Grandpa. I secured the first rank in the school. All my friends are way behind me.” “But Samyak. The Assessment sheet doesn’t say good about your behaviour.” “Grandpa, is that something to care about? Check out my marks. You will be stunned.”
“How was your performance in sports?” “Lower than normal. Ravinder always does well in sports. A vagabond!”

“And how is your performance in music and singing?” “Grandpa, when I sing, the whole class just runs away. Ritu, Varma uncle’s daughter, sings very well. Because of her, my school stood first in the entire state in the singing competition.”

“Samyak, you are an intelligent guy. Tell me how does a rainbow get formed?” “Grandpa, fine drops of water remain present in the air after rainfall. When the sunrays go through these drops, it gets split into seven colours.”

﻿ “You are right Samyak. A rainbow never forms in dry air. Similarly, you can never appreciate others’ talents with a narrow vision! Just like air when it gets enriched with water droplets it forms a rainbow if you can enrich your vision, you begin to see special talents in not only the people around you but also in plants and animals.” .
Samyak’s views had changed. He could rainbow of different colours not just in his class, but in the entire world.
